_documentation: This file is downloaded at app startup (GitHub raw). Only root key "message" is used for console output.
Any other root keys (like this array) are ignored by the program — safe for notes / reminders.
"message" entries require "text" (string). "format" is optional: prefer a JSON array of strings, e.g. ["green"] or ["hide"] for debugging (hidden blocks are not printed).

"text" line breaks: use 
 escapes inside the string value. 

 gives a blank line; printing uses end="" so newlines come from the string.

Format tags are matched case-insensitively. "hide" skips the segment. Color tags red / green / blue: at most one applies, precedence red > green > blue. Legacy one-string format is split on whitespace.
本文件在程序启动时从 GitHub raw 拉取。只有根对象的 "message" 数组会用于控制台输出。
其余根字段（例如本说明）程序会忽略，可随意写备注、约定或草稿。
"message" 中每项：必须有 "text"（字符串）；"format" 推荐为字符串数组，例如 ["green"] 或 ["hide"]（调试时不输出该段）。
"text" 换行使用 JSON 中的 \n；程序 print(end="")，由字符串内换行控制折行。
格式标签不区分大小写。含 hide 则整段不打印。颜色标签 red / green / blue 至多生效一个，优先级 红 > 绿 > 蓝。旧写法 format 为单个字符串时仍支持，会按空白拆成多个标签。
